storyCards.headline: Whip It: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Devo's "Whip It" reached #14 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Whip It" is a song by American new wave band Devo from their third studio album Freedom of Choice (1980).

It is a new wave and synth-pop song that features a synthesizer, electric guitar, bass guitar, and drums in its instrumentation.

The apparently nonsensical lyrics have a common theme revolving around the ability to deal with one's problems by "whipping it".

The song peaked at #14 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 25 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #14 on the Hot 100.
